executionCheckoutNote: The packages and test trees, and the three benchmark scripts, are identical to the tested v0.2.2 commit; the checkout adds report and plotting files only.
loadMonitor: psutil 7.2.2 cpu_percent(interval=5) and os.getloadavg; machine-wide, including benchmark work. Stage label is recorded at the end of each sampling interval.
quietStartGate: Two consecutive 5-second samples with CPU busy <= 30% and 1-minute load <= 10.
summary: Pre-existing compaction-summary.txt; no model invoked during rerun.
limitations: Shared machine; sampled load includes benchmark work and is not complete isolation.
All benchmark searches use LocalStoreCore default rerank weights; model-specific AgentMemory profiles and live agents were not benchmarked.
Token counts use character-based estimates; no memory_open call or model answer is timed.
